llm.summary: This skill is a coherent marketing-feedback workflow that analyzes launch feedback and only stores scoped summaries with user approval.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is launch-window feedback triage, status-loop planning, and compliant review/testimonial protocol design; the requested reads and outputs fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact has clear scope limits, tells the agent to treat feedback text as untrusted data, avoids roadmap decisions and outreach execution, and hands off unrelated work.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no install script, hidden code, or automatic runtime behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may process customer comments, reviews, support tickets, and optional keyless connector pulls, which is expected for feedback synthesis but can include sensitive business or user data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to named memory paths and candidate files, with explicit instructions to ask before writing durable results and not to write registry or decisions directly.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, consider that this skill may handle private customer feedback, reviews, and support-ticket excerpts. Use it with exports you are allowed to process, review any proposed memory writes before approving them, and independently verify platform review-incentive rules when using its social-proof harvest protocol.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean] expected: No advisory issues were reported; artifact review found no contradictory suspicious behavior.
